sections.label: Public Service external environment challenges
sections.summary: The Public Service faces a volatile external environment, higher domestic expectations, and tighter resources, requiring work with likeminded partners to uphold global rules.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Our Public Service faces a more volatile external environment, a domestic population with higher expectations, and a need to deliver its work well, within tighter resource constraints.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: Externally, Singapore will need to navigate the increasing contestation of great powers in geopolitics, trade, technology, and security.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will have to work with likeminded partners to uphold the global rules-based geopolitical and trade order.

sections.label: Shrinking labour force and ageing population
sections.summary: A shrinking labour force and ageing population will constrain the Public Service's size and the talent share it can take from the economy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: A shrinking labour force and ageing population will constrain the size of our Public Service and the share of talent that our Public Service can reasonably take from the broader economy.

sections.label: Public Sector S&T Policy and Plans Office
sections.summary: The Public Sector S&T Policy and Plans Office was set up to coordinate S&T capability planning, aggregate demand for efficiency, and train S&T experts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: For instance, we have set up the Public Sector S&T Policy and Plans Office (S&TPPO) to coordinate the planning of S&T capabilities, aggregate demand for greater efficiency as well as train a strong pool of S&T experts.

sections.label: Jobseekers placed into jobs and training
sections.summary: Through partnership with unions and employers, about 13,000 jobseekers, including new graduates, mid-career jobseekers, and retrenched workers, were placed into new jobs and training.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: For instance, through close partnership with the unions and employers, some 13,000 jobseekers – including new graduates, mid-career jobseekers, and retrenched workers – have been placed into new jobs and training opportunities.

sections.label: Building a future-ready Public Service
sections.summary: The Public Service will deepen its ethos, groom leaders, strengthen values, competencies, and accountability through 360° feedback and coaching, to be future-ready.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will deepen our Public Service ethos in our people and groom leaders who can lead their organisations to deliver well today, while building new capabilities to prepare for tomorrow’s challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We will strengthen Public Service values, competencies, and accountability among our leaders through wider adoption of 360° feedback and coaching.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
sentences.text: We are committed to build a future-ready Public Service that will serve Singapore and Singaporeans well into the future.
